quickAnswer: To get an accurate, honest response from Itinerary of Türkiye (ITO), send just five practical details: your approximate dates, group size and ages, core interests, preferred travel pace, and realistic budget band. Keep passports, medical records, and payment cards completely out of your first message—our two founders reply directly and quote a flat planning fee before any paid work starts.

body.text: What 5 Details (Dates, Group Size, Interests, Pace, Budget Band) Let ITO Build an Accurate Plan?

Sharing five concrete facts up front lets [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/) skip generic templates and tell you immediately what fits your timeframe. Even rough answers—such as "10 days in late October" or "two adults plus one teenager"—are far more useful than leaving everything open-ended.

items: Approximate Dates & Flexibility: Exact arrival/departure days or a preferred month, plus whether you are open to shoulder-season dates (see our [winter Türkiye travel guide](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/turkey-in-winter-premium-travel-guide) if considering December–March).
Group Size & Mobility: Total travellers, children's ages, and any mobility or stair-free room requirements.

Core Interests: Leisure travel (archaeology, architecture, slow rail via [TCDD YHT](https://www.tcddtasimacilik.gov.tr/en/high_speed_train), culinary stops like [Bursa](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/destinations/bursa)), business visits, or practical coordination around a medical trip.
Preferred Pace: Fast multi-region highlights or unhurried three-night bases with unscheduled afternoons.
Realistic Budget Band: An honest range for hotels, private transport, and guides so we only recommend options that match your expectations.

body.text: What Sensitive Information (Passports, Medical Records, Cards) Should Stay Out of Your First Message?

Never attach passport photos, national ID scans, clinical lab reports, medical imaging, bank statements, or credit card numbers to a first website form, email, or WhatsApp message. Standard initial contact channels are designed for high-level trip scoping—not confidential personal or health records.

As stated on [Itinerary of Türkiye's homepage](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/), we explain the appropriate, secure channel if confidential documents are ever required later for flight ticketing, hotel registration, or coordinating with a licensed clinic. For medical travellers, remember that ITO coordinates logistics, provider credential checks, translation, and transfers, while diagnosis and clinical decisions belong strictly to your licensed medical team (see also [UK FCDO guidance on health and medical travel in Türkiye](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/turkey/health)).

items: Remove passport numbers, birth dates, and ID scans from your initial message.
Keep diagnostic files, prescriptions, and clinical photos out of first enquiries.
Never share credit card numbers, CVV codes, or bank details by email or chat.
State only your preferred language (English, Turkish, German, or Russian) and best way to reach you.
Mention the broad medical or business purpose in one plain sentence without private records.

body.text: How Does the Flat Planning Fee and Written Proposal Process Work?

[Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/) operates on a strict client-paid model: "Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions." Before any paid planning begins, we discuss your brief and quote a clear, flat planning fee in writing, set out completely separately from third-party hotel, driver, guide, or clinic costs.

Once you approve the fee, we research availability, vet local providers, and deliver a structured written plan showing route logic, realistic transit times, and transparent provider pricing—with zero hidden markups or kickbacks from carpet shops, hotels, or clinics. You know exactly what you pay ITO for advisory work and what you pay each provider directly.
How Quickly Does a Real Founder or Local Advisor Reply?

Because [ITO is run directly by its two founders in Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about)—not an outsourced call centre or automated chatbot—every enquiry is read by the people who actually live on the ground and build your plan. Most enquiries receive a personal founder reply within one business day (often faster during Istanbul daytime hours, TRT / UTC+3), coming back with focused follow-up questions, honest feasibility checks, and a clear next step.

Ready to start? Send your five core details through [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/) in English, Turkish, German, or Russian—and remember to keep passport or ID scans, medical or financial records, and payment details out of your first enquiry.

faq.q: Is there a fee for sending a first enquiry to Itinerary of Türkiye?
faq.a: No. Your initial enquiry and scoping conversation are free. ITO quotes a flat planning fee in writing before any paid itinerary design or provider coordination work begins, so there are no surprise charges.

faq.q: Does ITO take commissions from hotels, restaurants, or clinics?
faq.a: No. ITO is 100% client-paid and independent of provider commissions. Recommendations are based strictly on fit, quality, and your stated budget band rather than referral kickbacks.

faq.q: What languages can I use in my first enquiry?
faq.a: You can write in English, Turkish, German, or Russian. Tell us your preferred language in your first message, and we will reply in that language and arrange any local translation support needed during your visit.

faq.q: How far in advance should I contact ITO before travelling to Türkiye?
faq.a: For peak spring (April–June) and autumn (September–October) trips—or multi-generational groups needing adjoining rooms—enquire 3 to 6 months ahead. For winter travel or short business visits, 4 to 8 weeks is usually enough.

faq.q: Can ITO help with business trips or medical travel as well as leisure holidays?
faq.a: Yes. Beyond private leisure itineraries, ITO supports executive business visits, trade-fair logistics, and practical coordination for medical travel (provider checks, appointments, transfers, and translation), while licensed doctors handle all clinical care.

faq.q: What if I do not have exact flight dates yet?
faq.a: That is completely fine. Share your target month, approximate trip length (for example, 9 to 12 nights), and any fixed constraints, and our founders will help you choose the smartest arrival and departure airports before you book flights.
